exclusions: Raw private reports, PCAP, credentials, user SIDs, handles, raw nonces, environment paths and temporary build outputs are not handoff payloads.
This is the 438-file Windows proof source closure, not a manifest of the entire application repository. The complete repository remains available at the bound commit.
source_binding: The commit that first adds this manifest is the source snapshot. Resolve with git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- docs/validation/windows-isolation-source-manifest.json. Verify every listed byte count and SHA256; this manifest intentionally does not include its own hash or a future commit hash. Later documentation-only commits do not change the listed source snapshot.
